name: Calyx
summary: Calyx is fully upholstered in rich, continuous fabric that gives the piece a smooth, sculpted profile. The tailored finish highlights its clean geometry, while the black lacquered metal legs add a sharp, modern contrast. The combination creates a bed that feels refined, contemporary and quietly indulgent. all covered with fabric, metal legs lacquered in black 241x328x85.5 (180×200)
